identity.name: Rare SMTP/S Session via Windows PowerShell
identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to establish an SMTP/S session to a remote server, likely for exfiltration or command execution. Cortex should detect this rare SMTP/S behavior and flag it as suspicious. T
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to establish an SMTP/S session to a remote server, likely for exfiltration or command execution. Cortex should detect this rare SMTP/S behavior and flag it as suspicious. The attack involves PowerShell script execution and network connections to a test-net IP.

payload.code: powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient('192.0.2.10', 25); $stream = $client.GetStream(); $writer = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter($stream); $writer.WriteLine('EHLO example.com'); $writer.Flush(); $writer.WriteLine('STARTTLS'); $writer.Flush(); $writer.WriteLine('QUIT'); $writer.Flush(); $client.Close();"

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: PowerShell SMTP/S Session
biocs.description: PowerShell script execution initiating an SMTP/S session to a non-standard port
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10' and dst_port = 25

abiocs.name: Rare SMTP/S Session Behavior
abiocs.description: Detects rare SMTP/S session initiated by PowerShell process, outside of normal behavior
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10' and dst_port = 25
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'

xql_queries.name: SMTP/S PowerShell Session Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10' and dst_port = 25
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name, action_remote_ip
